description: The run defaults that a preset and the project settings share. A null value sets no default.

create_pr.description: Whether the agent opens a pull request when it finishes. Null uses the product default.

idle_minutes.description: How many minutes the sandbox waits with no activity before it stops, from 1 to 120. The run is then `idle`, and a message continues it. While the agent is in the middle of a turn, the sandbox waits 10 minutes at least. Null uses the product default, 10.

inference.description:
How the agent pays for model usage. `auto` uses your own subscription when one is connected for the runtime, and PostHog inference otherwise. Null uses the product default.

* `auto` - Auto
* `own_subscription` - Own Subscription
* `posthog` - PostHog

instructions.description: Instructions that the agent gets before the prompt. Project instructions come first, then preset instructions, then the instructions of the run.

model.description: Default model for the agent. Null lets PostHog select the model.

name.description: Name of the preset. It is unique in the project, without regard to case.

output_schema.description: A JSON Schema with `type` set to `object`. When set, the agent must return a JSON result that matches it, and the run returns the result in `result.output`. Null asks for no structured result.

anyOf.description:
* `low` - Low
* `medium` - Medium
* `high` - High
* `xhigh` - Extra high
* `max` - Max
* `ultracode` - Ultracode

reasoning_effort.description:
How much the model reasons before it answers. A model supports only some of the values. Null uses the default of the model.

* `low` - Low
* `medium` - Medium
* `high` - High
* `xhigh` - Extra high
* `max` - Max
* `ultracode` - Ultracode

initial_branch.description: Branch that the agent starts from. Null uses the default branch of the repository.

repositories.description: Default repositories that the agent works in. Only one repository is supported for now. Null sets no default.

anyOf.description:
* `1x2` - 1 vCPU, 2 GiB
* `2x4` - 2 vCPU, 4 GiB
* `2x8` - 2 vCPU, 8 GiB
* `4x8` - 4 vCPU, 8 GiB
* `4x16` - 4 vCPU, 16 GiB
* `8x16` - 8 vCPU, 16 GiB
* `8x32` - 8 vCPU, 32 GiB
* `16x64` - 16 vCPU, 64 GiB

size.description:
Default sandbox size, as `<vCPU>x<memory in GiB>`. Null uses the product default.

* `1x2` - 1 vCPU, 2 GiB
* `2x4` - 2 vCPU, 4 GiB
* `2x8` - 2 vCPU, 8 GiB
* `4x8` - 4 vCPU, 8 GiB
* `4x16` - 4 vCPU, 16 GiB
* `8x16` - 8 vCPU, 16 GiB
* `8x32` - 8 vCPU, 32 GiB
* `16x64` - 16 vCPU, 64 GiB

tags.description: Tags added to every run that uses this preset.
